name: REV - Home Internet, TV, & Security
old_description: Since 1935, REV has been committed to not only being the best telecommunications provider but also to the growth and prosperity of South Louisiana. Through our involvement in and support of education, the arts, civic groups and non-profit organizations throughout South Louisiana, REV has always demonstrated its dedication to actively shaping and strengthening this special place we call home.
about:
REV is headquartered in Reserve, Louisiana, and traces its roots to 1935 when it began as a local telecommunications provider serving South Louisiana. The company operates as a private-owned entity and was restructured in 2020 as the combined parent of RTC, EATEL, EATEL Business, and Vision Communications, rebranding to REV in 2022. No individual founders are named in the available materials.

The company delivers fiber-optic internet, television, phone, and home security services to residential and business customers across its footprint. Its network spans more than 2,790 miles of fiber, supported by nearly 400 employees who serve over 60,000 customers. REV also operates VENYU, a cloud hosting, data center, and data protection provider with facilities in Louisiana and partner locations nationwide. Services include symmetrical gigabit internet with no data caps, whole-home WiFi using eero hardware, and managed modem provisioning.

REV serves communities from Baton Rouge to Grand Isle, covering the Bayou Region (Lafourche, Terrebonne, Grand Isle), River Region (St. James, St. John the Baptist), Capital Region (Ascension, East Baton Rouge, Iberville, Livingston), and the Shreveport/Bossier area. Its customer base includes households, businesses, and local non-profits such as Alzheimer's Services of the Capital Area and Volunteer Ascension, which have received grants through the company's employee-guided REVolutionizing Communities program.

REV emphasizes its local presence and community investment as key differentiators. It highlights no-contract, no-cap internet plans, symmetrical upload and download speeds, and customer service staffed by local representatives. The company also points to its employee-driven philanthropic voting process and the integration of VENYU's coast-to-coast data center network as factors that set it apart from national providers.
